pkgmetadata.longdescription: agent-browser (vercel-labs) is a native Rust CLI that launches and drives a Chromium-family browser over the Chrome DevTools Protocol for AI agents: navigation, accessibility-tree snapshots with element refs, clicks, typing and screenshots. Hermes Agent's built-in browser tools use it. Built from source; the npm/cargo self-upgrade is disabled because Portage owns the installed files.
